issues.where: soil mound behind and around the seedling, f0109 to f0130
issues.what: the large mound of clods that sits behind the plant from f0000 to f0109 is gone by f0130 and the ground is flat, with no settling or crumbling between. In the video it reads as the set being swapped
issues.fix: keep the mound across the whole segment, or let it crumble and slump gradually as the seedling pushes up

issues.where: grass clump right of the seedling, f0087 to f0130
issues.what: the clump is barely there at f0087, then stands as tall blades by f0109 and is full height by f0130. That is far faster than the seedling grows, so it looks like it pops in
issues.fix: put the clump in from the first frame, or grow it at the seedling's rate

issues.where: seed head and hypocotyl hook, f0066 to f0077
issues.what: the head turns about 70 degrees from hanging to upright in 0.37 s and the hook straightens like a rigid hinge. The stem's curvature flips without any visible lag or follow-through from base to tip
issues.fix: slow the straightening, let it travel from the base up the stem, and give the head a slight lag and settle

issues.where: dark specks on the stem and in the air beside it, all frames
issues.what: the black specks on the stem and the floating specks jump to new positions, appear and vanish from frame to frame instead of staying on the surface or falling smoothly, so they flicker and crawl
issues.fix: stick the specks to the stem surface, or give falling particles steady paths, and remove any that are only per-frame noise

issues.what: the shed hull hangs high in the air to the left of the stem, well away from the cotyledons, then sits on the soil at f0130. Its path does not follow on from where it came off
issues.fix: have the hull slip off the cotyledon tips and drop along a short, weighted path beside the stem

issues.where: edge of the hull and the stem outline, f0070 to f0077
issues.what: the light rim on the hull and stem edges shimmers slightly between frames when zoomed in
issues.fix: stabilise edge anti-aliasing and rim lighting over time

issues.where: mist band on the horizon, f0130 onward
issues.what: a pale band of mist appears at the horizon partway through without drifting in
issues.fix: build the mist up gradually with slow sideways drift from the start of the segment
